title: CandidateFilter
description: A schema for filtering candidates based on user queries. All fields are optional.

total_experience_years.description: Filter by candidate's total career experience (from candidates.total_experience_years)

location.description: Filter by candidate's current location (from candidates.location or candidates.city)

management_experience.description: Filter by team management experience (from candidates.max_people_managed or candidates.years_team_management)

education.description: Filter by education history (from education table)

experience_gaps.description: Filter by career gaps (from candidates.has_gap_years or experience_gaps table)

has_gaps.description: True to find candidates with gaps, False for those without.

max_gap_duration_months.description: Find candidates with no single gap longer than this.

roles.description: Filter by specific roles. This will JOIN roles and companies. All criteria inside an object are AND-ed.

min_duration_years.description: Minimum years in a role with this title

company.description: Filter the company for this specific role (from companies table)

precomputed_scores.description: Filter using the pre-calculated scores (e.g., functional_experience_score)
